text:
I had an absolutely amazing experience at Phuket Dental. I came in for a teeth cleaning and whitening, and the results are incredible. My teeth look fantastic, and the difference is huge. I’ll be posting before-and-after photos because the whitening results really speak for themselves.

The staff was extremely nice, attentive, caring, and professional from start to finish. They made me feel completely comfortable the entire time, and I had absolutely no pain whatsoever. Everything was smooth, clean, and handled with real care.

I’m genuinely impressed with the results and the service. I would highly recommend Phuket Dental to anyone looking for teeth cleaning, whitening, or dental care in Phuket.

I had two implants and implant crowns done here and I’m very happy with the result.

The whole treatment process was smooth and professional. The clinic is modern, very clean, and the staff were always friendly and helpful.

Most importantly, the final result looks natural, feels comfortable, and works perfectly. Thank you to the doctors and the entire team for taking such good care of me throughout the treatment.

I would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for quality dental treatment in Phuket.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a great experience at Phuket Dental Signature Clinic. I came in for a professional teeth cleaning and repair of two chipped front teeth.

The cleaning was done perfectly, and the repair work was excellent. I’m writing this review two months later, and my teeth are still in perfect condition. Even though the material used to repair chipped teeth can sometimes be fragile, everything is holding up beautifully.

The dentist and staff were super nice, professional, and made me feel very comfortable throughout the visit. I’m very happy with the results and truly appreciate the care and skill of the team.

Highly recommended. Thank you very much!

This was the best dental experience I’ve ever had. I cracked my tooth whilst travelling and was worried about getting it fixed quickly. I was able to get a walk in appointment and got seen to straight away. My Dentist (Dr. Pranee) and her assistant, were amazing. They were so lovely and kind. They took their time to explain everything and the whole experience was smooth, efficient and extremely professional. I get particularly nervous around dental injections, but the whole process was pain free!  I had to have 3 fillings and it was very reasonably priced (much cheaper than the UK). My boyfriend also had a check up with Dr. Joe, which was also a great experience. I can’t recommend this place enough. (Everyone also spoke great English)

I am a tourist Chinese American from United States. Originally, I plan on getting a teeth whitening while visiting Thailand. The staff is very honest and informed me that I don’t need teeth whiting done but just need a cleaning. They told me that my teeth is white enough as it is and decided to give me the teeth cleaning treatment instead really appreciate honesty. They did a really good job cleaning the teeth as well. I will highly recommend it.

Had a check up with the best deep clean I’ve had in 50 years for only £23 Stirling, less than a third of the price compared to UK prices and so much better. Will be making this an annual trip to get it done, so very thorough!

The team at Phuket Dental Signature Clinic are very professional, experienced and friendly. Excellent hygiene standards. If foreigners aren't sure about going to a dentist in Thailand, be rest assured that you will be impressed.
From reception to all the dentists, efficient and professional service. Very thorough care taken and at a very reasonable price, thank you!
I came on dec 30th for cleaning & whitening. Staff was friendly, understanding and were incredible They explained everything clearly.. pricing too was very reasonable
I have a very nice experience in the clinic. The place is incredibly clean. The staffs are polite. The doctor is very nice and kind. Highly recommended
Very happy with composite fillings and veneers. Great service and amazing work!

Last minute decision to get a couple of fillings done, to then getting crowns done on 4 of my teeth which had previous root canals done in Australia, which evetually resulted in discoloured teeth. Very very happy with the service, price and dental work done. I will definitely be returning on my next trip to Patong.

Had tooth pain while travelling Thailand and was able to get a quick appointment. The clinic was clean, professional, and efficient. The dentist spoke great English and gave me a clear diagnosis with treatment options tailored to my travel plans. Quick, thorough, and very affordable. Highly recommend!
Excellent dental practice. Very clean, professional, modern and great bedside manner. Highly recommend.

Cannot fault them, professional all the way, had 7 fillings, teeth cleaning, 2 extractions, temporary fake tooth. Just had strauman implant. Hollywood dentists. No pressure, free quotes and free consultations very good communication. Did not feel any pain at all. Did plenty of research went to 4 dentists for quotes what a disaster... These guys are definitely the best crew in Patong with great prices and great free advice. Do not go anywhere else!!!

Great Price!
Great Service!
Great Staff!
Felt hesitant before initial consult, however the Dentist & Staff's humble,professional demeanor, made the process very easy.
Fitting of veneers was delayed by 2 days, with overall completion of 7 days, which for me was OUTSTANDING!!!
4 Veneers & a Filling :)

I have dislike my teeth my whole adult life and been very self conscious about them, I had thought about getting a smile makeover for years. I travelled from New Zealand and after a couple of appointments and going back and forth I ended up getting 4 crowns and 4 veneers on my front 8 top teeth. I was nervous at first but the dentist was so professional and all the staff were so friendly. It’s been a month since I have had them done and it’s was the best decision I ever made for my self confidence! I really wanted the teeth to look “natural” and didn’t want any crazy white or weirdly shaped veneers and they really achieved this for me. If end up doing my bottom teeth or need anything else done I won’t hesitate to go back to Phuket dental signature!

This was the best dental experience I've ever had, mainly down to the lovely and friendly reception staff and the excellent dentist I saw. Had an x-ray done of my teeth, an inspection and levelling of two of the molars and a great explanation of what was happening from the dentist and I was extremely happy with what she did. Not only that, it was not expensive and I was delighted with the whole experience, so I will definitely go back when necessary and I can recommend them.

The dental team is very professional, honest and caring. They didn't try to upsell any services or products, despite having many opportunities.  They were only concerned for the patient's best interest.  She had 4 fillings done in one session and felt no pain during or after.  She consulted with two specialists at no cost or commitments.  I would be comfortable going to this clinic for more complex work, including implants, in the future.

I've visited Dental Signature Patong 3 times over 2 years now, and they have been wonderful. From reception to the dental care staff, including the Dentist and Nurse, just great service. My most recent procedure was the removal of a wisdom tooth last weekend. Their care was first class.

I always get my teeth cleaned every 6 months, Dr. Vissavet Aksornkaew DDS was very professional and thorough, spoke very good English, he did a great job. The Dental clinic was very clean, efficient and very professional. Managed to get seen straight alway. I Highly recommended.

I had three implants done this year and I am very happy with the result. They were completed in two trips over 12 months. What I saw was professionalism. If they see things that need to do done, regardless of the complicity. They don’t ignore them, they always took the most professional path. This is precisely what I was looking for.  I would certainly use them again.

The dental signature service  clinic  was fantastic it was easy to find the staff were wonderful vey perfosseional contacting us via WhatsApp keeping us up to date on appointments Dr Jo was wonderful when attending my appointments  meaning goo g

out of his way to do the coloring for my crowns to get it right
Service was excellent and and professional

Arrived from the UK with terrible toothache, after a filling I'd had a few days earlier at my own Dentist, I got a same day appointment & consultation. Arranged a second appointment 2 days later for an Extraction, they were absolutely brilliant throughout, can't thank them enough, felt really looked after despite being a little worried having not had a tooth out in many years. Would highly recommend this Dental practice, also very reasonable prices & far cheaper than the UK! Thank you.

Highly recommended! I called, explained the situation and got for the same day an appointment. The staff was friendly and could speak good English. The doctor was very good, she recommended me the best treatment and not the most expensive one, which I appreciated. They are very nice and professional!

I had an Amazing experience with Dr. Jugkrit Bunyakitanon.
I had done a Full mouth rehabilitation in my 4 weeks over there in Phuket. And after 18 months everything still looks and feels Great.
The Staff and the Dr JUG are high Caliber Professionals.
Thank you for all your services and Caring.

Gil Goncalves
Sydney/Australia

Very professional and very pleasant staff with the up most professional equipment. I will highly recommend  if your coming to Thailand and need dental  work done please get in contact with  them. 5 out of 5 stars.

Am VERY pleased with how my dental work here worked out. I had significant sinus damage from a bad Covid situation in early 2020, causing me to lose a half dozen teeth in my top-left quadrant. Signature repaired that damage, and across …

Although I researched plenty about dentists in Thailand and saw the reviews I was still worried about getting dental work completed. I had 6x veneers put in and they look amazing. Had a check up today at my Australian dentist clinic who inspected them and reported the work completed was of a very high level and there are no problems with them whatsoever. Cannot praise Phuket dental signature enough for the communication they provided, the prices given and the great quality of work that was provided. I would return in the future for any future major work required definitely.

Pleasant staff
Professional Doctors
Painless and efficient
Thank you for you help

I used guys these 12 years ago for 2 caps and still to this day my dentist at home says what a great job on them, still going strong.

It’s great to see these guys are still here doing a great job, I was only searching by chance and they popped up, will be looking forward to heading back there today

I had implants and crowns done at Phuket Dental Signature over a 6 month period and have been very pleased with the outcome.  My teeth look and feel very natural and the dentists were extremely efficient and competent.   I  am happy to recommend them as being cost effective and professional.
Good place, professional services, friendly care. Thanks a lot

booked a specific doctor after reading his bio online consider it might be quite a risk to see a Thai doctor so I was very careful with dentist selection. When I arrived, I was given a different doctor who barely spoke English without any explaination . There is no information of that doctor on website, and other then saying sorry, the reception staff essentially didn't care of wasting my time of traveling and effort.

The whole clinic felt very commercial to me, and little sincerity.  It was a bad choice and I end up wasted my time of traveling there and all other clinics was fully booked (while this clinic still had availability on the same day to treat in walk in customer)
The clinic does not guarantee the fillings and does not return the money. I had a retainer installed, which came off after a week. They refused to return the money. The service is expensive.
Dropped by for a cleaning and was impressed.  I felt the dentist knew what she was doing and she was quick and effective.  Price was very fair.  I would return.

100% recommend. I think my biggest compliment was the fact that whilst the dentist was working on me I heard giggling. I realised that I had fallen asleep in the chair and was snoring (3 times). I have nothing but praise for my dentist, Kris and the team (reception/ X-rays/ specialists and dental assistants)
I needed a fair amount of work done from molars, general fillings and a front tooth bridge. I was “time poor” and on a budget. I did a fair amount of web research and decided on Phuket Dental Signature primary because the quick and professional responses from Kris and the highly comprehensive and detailed plan that was worked out before I even left Australia. I told her that as I was on holiday I was only prepared to visit the clinic 3 times. She listened and came up with 3 options. Urgent to everything including a price quote for each option. (this was based on an old OPG)
When I arrived at the clinic I was given a medical by the very friendly and efficient front line staff then taken to the dentist for a FREE consultation. We worked through the various plans and was given a pretty accurate quote.
My choice was to have 3 x 4 HOUR sessions. 2 x root canals, numerous fillings, cleaning and a 3 tooth upper front bridge. Amazing. The best part was I was called in for a check-up with both the dentist and specialist (a bit of grinding here and there and a filling replaced). This last consult of 1.5 hours was FREE. Lastly I had call from Kris to inform me that there was a slight accounting error and I had a refund due !!!

I called last minute and was able to get in. They also had time to do exam, bid, clean and remove a tooth. Very clean, professional, and did a great job. I had my teeth cleaned, chip fixed, bleached, and tooth removed at a fraction of the US prices. Highly recommend this team.

Went here today for a general clean up and phrophylaxis as I was in the area. Just passed by and walked in and amazingly was able to be serviced straight away at a very fair price. Staff and dentist were all very professional and clinic looks great. 5 stars for your service - thank you.

The staff here are very kind and professional. I had some fillings and a wisdom tooth extraction. The dentist was very gentle and did a great job. Highly recommended. The price was great too. I will be back.

I went to the Dental Signature Clinic in Phuket for a root canal treatment and two crowns. It has been a great experience. All people there are very competent and friendly, very helpful. They are also very punctual in the appointment, no …

I had a very good experience. Even that the cabinet had just closed, the kind lady let me in and gave me an appointment. The very next day, the woman dentist made a free check, gave me some good advise and she was very professional. Thank you.

This clinic has been recommended to me. It is clean, the staff is super nice. All the dentists and their assistants are very professional and helped me relax when   they were operating (I am very scared of dentist). Great dental clinic !

I’ve had my teeth whitened and a crown replaced. At this point I still have a temporary crown, but I can say that the dentist is very gentle and efficient. The temporary crown is already beautiful and it was a painless procedure. Quite thankful, and this will be my go-to place for all things dental.

Really good experience. I did the home tooth bleaching on a whim when I passed by the dental center on a rainy day. The service is fast, excellent and it is much cheaper than in my country. I highly recommend.

I cannot remember my dentist's name but she was wonder. Great knowledge, expertise and well-oiled system going. I was in and out. No problems and affordable price. I will definitely go again. Thank you for the pleasant appointment.

I would like to give a full report of my experience at Phuket dental signature clinic in 2017 March/April. I had waited a very long time to get my veneers done at this clinic and even waited for a particular dentist who is a specialist in cosmetic dentistry by the name of Dr. Kulkarn Sakulthap. The entire process of the veneers was rushed.  This is a tourist clinic and I learned this the hard way and their goal is to get patients in and out as quickly as possible to turn around to new patients.  When getting veneers, it is very important t to have them customized to your look and desire and it is not uncommon for veneers to be sent back to the lab for shape and size adjustments to get things just right. After my veneers came back from the lab I was told that the clinic would not change the shape or work on the coloring and finish of the veneers and as a result, I had overly white, too perfect looking veneers cemented permanently in my mouth despite verbalizing that I thought they weren’t the right look.  I was basically told that the Dr. knows his craft and to just trust him. Horrible mistake.  I was asked numerous times over the past couple of years whether my teeth were real and even asked whether I had veneers done.  If this isn’t a sign that the work of a ‘cosmetic dentist’ wasn’t a disaster, I don’t know what is!

The clinic is absolutely beautiful and I do believe they have great dentists for general dentistry and minor cosmetic work (bonding, whitening etc.). However, I cannot emphasize enough NEVER to get your veneers or smile makeovers done at a clinic like this which is only about volume of customers and not about customizing and working with a client to reach a good level of satisfaction.

Short form: visit for cleanings, fillings, root canals etc.  DO NOT get smile makeovers/veneers here!

I wasted over 3,000 USD and just two years later getting them all redone because of how fake they looked.  Thankfully, this time I’m working with a clinic in Mumbai, India that caters to celebrities and a local clientele and while the process has been more time consuming, I now see all the shortcomings of my first smile makeover with Dr. sakulthap and the failure of this clinic to live up to its promises.
Extremely professional and lovely staff! The clinic is clean and beautiful. Recieved great results and felt safe and in good hands the whole time. They really know what they are doing :D

Had a denture made and is absolutely perfect first time ! Don’t even know I have it in !
Highly recommend the service and quality of work !

Great staff and service. Very welcoming as soon as I walked thru the door. Very professional throughtout process. Clean centre/building. I am pleased with the end result. I had a deep clean and i honestly didnt think my teeth were that bad until after the procedure was done. Quality service 🙌🏾🙌🏾 …

This is the first time we have sought dental treatment outside Australia. We have the highest praise for Dental Signature Phuket. The quality and standard of care has exceeded our experiences back home. The value for money also can’t be ignored. Irrespective of the cost savings we would recommend this company to all. The services we received were cleaning, whitening, filling and a crown. We’ve left very happy. Thank you.
Prob better for you to shop around
Teeth cleaning and whitening was good. I like the result.
Fantastic service & results!  A wonderful experience all around, thank you! 🙏 …
Fast appointments good service
Amazing!!!

It seemed like a good place, but I made an appointment for a filling on Saturday morning because I was experiencing severe toothache. They scheduled an appointment for 3:00 a.m., but upon arrival they said their doctor couldn't do anything and only had time for a diagnosis. As it turns out, all other clinics are open until 5:00 p.m., and most are closed tomorrow because it's Sunday, and then there's a holiday until Friday.
I wasted my time and ended up with 4-5 days of severe toothache.
Very professional treatment and very friendly staff. Excellent consultation. We were very impressed and can highly recommend it.

Excellent practice. He has two offices, Kathu and Thalang. A professional doctor. Meticulous, attentive, and knows his stuff. (Friendly). Very kind chairside assistants. Practice equipped with excellent, modern equipment. Competitive price. After fixing my tooth (which was badly positioned), he gave me a free dental cleaning and filed down a tooth that was chattering badly. All included in the same price. I am very satisfied. He will be my trusted dentist. I highly recommend him.
Good job
Very good.
Very professional and friendly institution. 🙂 …
All perfect 👌 …

Service 10/10
Value for money 10/10
Quickness to get an appointment 10/10
Cleanliness 10/10

My crown came loose, and I received help here within one hour. Everyone was very friendly and accommodating. The dentist was simply top-notch; his work was so clean. If I have another dental problem, this will be my first choice. I felt very well cared for. And the value for money is simply excellent… 👍🏻🙏 Thank you!

I'm a tourist from Hat Yai and I came here for dental treatment. The atmosphere is great, clean, and not crowded. The dentist is very kind and gentle. The counter staff are very cheerful and friendly. I would highly recommend it. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Made a filling and everything went well
Best best best
Friendly. Efficient. Recommended
The lady dentist was very informative. So gentle and nice
The clinic is clean, the doctor is very kind and has a very gentle touch.
